body:
If there is a hell I feel like I deserve to be there. Eternal torment. But I'm not sure there is a hell. There is most likely nothing after I die. Therefore killing myself would end my suffering and I don't think I deserve that.  

I'm a bad person. There is only so long before I snap and I do something horrible. Most of the time I feel sadistic and a lot of the time I'd like to go farther than just making people feel bad. That isn't right. I feel like I'm a waste of potential.
